brandProfile.name: Lumina Skincare
brandProfile.description: Evidence-backed clean skincare and wellness direct-to-consumer brand.

facts.text: Free delivery applies to all orders above ₹499 within India.
facts.conditions: Order subtotal >= ₹499; valid across India; standard delivery only

facts.text: Orders placed before 2:00 PM IST Monday to Friday are dispatched on the same business day.
facts.conditions: Monday to Friday only; order confirmed before 14:00 IST; excludes national holidays

facts.text: Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days for metro locations and 5 to 7 business days for rest of India.
facts.conditions: Business days only; metro cities include Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Chennai, Kolkata, Hyderabad

facts.text: Unopened products in original packaging can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a 100% refund.
facts.conditions: Item must be unopened with safety seal intact; return initiated within 30 days of delivery

facts.text: First-time customers receive a flat 15% discount using coupon code FIRST15 on minimum cart value of ₹999.
facts.conditions: Valid once per user account; first purchase only; minimum order value ₹999; cannot combine with other codes

facts.text: All skincare formulations are dermatologically tested and certified cruelty-free by PETA.
facts.conditions: Certified under PETA Beauty Without Bunnies program 2025-2027; independent dermatology patch tests

facts.text: Customer support is available Monday through Saturday from 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM IST via in-app chat and email.
facts.conditions: Monday through Saturday 09:00-20:00 IST; closed on Sundays and gazetted national holidays

facts.text: Annual Gold Club membership costs ₹1,499 per year and provides 5% cashback on every purchase.
facts.conditions: Membership valid for 365 days; cashback credited to Lumina Wallet; non-transferable

facts.text: Express next-day delivery is available for ₹99 exclusively in Mumbai, Bengaluru, and Delhi NCR.
facts.conditions: Orders placed before 12:00 PM; pincodes within designated metro municipal limits only; flat fee ₹99

facts.text: All packaging boxes and filler materials are made from 100% biodegradable post-consumer recycled paper.
facts.conditions: Outer shipping boxes and paper void fill; certified FSC Recycled

facts.text: Complimentary 50ml trial moisturizer is included with every skincare purchase above ₹1,999 while stock lasts.
facts.conditions: Order value after discounts >= ₹1,999; skincare category only; while promotional stock lasts

facts.text: Gift cards are valid for 12 months from the date of purchase and are non-refundable.
facts.conditions: Valid for exactly 365 days; cannot be exchanged for cash or reloaded
facts.provenance: Gift Voucher Terms & RBI PPI Guidelines

terms.reason: Standard brand terminology is 'free delivery', never 'free shipping'.
Regulatory compliance: cosmetic formulations contain clean, safe preservatives.
Support team is not active 24/7; only Mon-Sat 9am-8pm IST.

terms.preferred: helps reduce the appearance of blemishes
terms.reason: Cosmetic products cannot make medical treatment or cure claims under drug regulations.
Delivery is conditional upon ₹499 cart threshold; never universally free.

banned: no questions asked returns on opened items
terms.preferred: 30-day return policy for unopened items in original packaging
terms.reason: Opened products cannot be returned for hygiene and safety reasons.
Express delivery is next-day in select metro areas, not on-demand instant delivery.
